# gitea_org_webhook (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve details of an organization webhook.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitea_org_webhook" "example" {
  org = "my-org"
  id  = 123
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Organization webhook ID
- `org` (String) Organization name

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the webhook is active
- `content_type` (String) The content type of the payload
- `events` (List of String) Events triggering the webhook
- `type` (String) Webhook type
- `url` (String) Target URL of the webhook
